title: Pushed source commits
responsibility: Selects new source-branch tips from the lines Git supplies to a pre-push hook.

inputs.name: pushedRefs.input
inputs.description: Git pre-push input containing four whitespace-separated fields per reference line.

outputs.name: pushedRefs
outputs.description: Unique local commit strings in encounter order for nondeleted updates to source branches. Malformed lines, deletions, evidence/notes/archive refs, tags and other refs are omitted.
